expectations.text: Uses cub unit apply (the apply verb), not kubectl apply or argocd app sync
Does NOT pass --change-desc on cub unit apply
expectations.evidence: Baseline invented --change-desc on cub unit apply — apply does not accept it (runtime operation, not config-data mutation).

expectations.text: Runs a --dry-run on a non-trivial apply before the real one
Preflights ApplyGates with a LEN(ApplyGates) > 0 check (or cub unit list with the gates filter)
On apply failure, does NOT retry blindly — collects bridgestate/worker logs and hands off
expectations.evidence: Baseline plan is 'retry once and then look at kubectl logs' — exactly the anti-pattern the skill warns against.

expectations.text: Hands off to verify-delivery after apply, both for success and failure cases
